description: Customer platform with marketing, sales, customer service, and CRM software tools
auth_notes: OAuth2 auth code for public apps and private app access tokens (bearer tokens)
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free HubSpot Developer account and create private apps or public apps for self-serve credentials.
api_notes: Extensive REST APIs covering CRM objects (contacts, companies, deals), marketing, conversations, workflows, and account settings.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by HubSpot; community options may exist.
rationale: HubSpot offers comprehensive REST APIs with self-serve developer account creation and access tokens, making it fully ready for integration.

evidence.note: Covers API reference, authentication overview, and endpoints structure.
Allows developers to create a free HubSpot Developer account self-serve.
Details comprehensive API surface including CRM, marketing, and CMS endpoints.
